notes: Successor to the T50 with larger tank (~55-60 L spray) and up to ~60 kg spreading payload, primarily released for the China/Asia agricultural market. Retains coaxial rotor layout, radar+vision fusion, and rapid-swap high-capacity batteries. Some specs are region-specific and not fully published in English; figures here are best estimates.

failure_modes.name: Spray line blockage
failure_modes.symptoms: Flow anomaly alerts, streaking in coverage maps
failure_modes.mitigation: Post-job flushing, inline filters, scheduled nozzle replacement

failure_modes.name: ESC failure under high payload takeoff
failure_modes.symptoms: Sudden motor loss, asymmetric thrust, emergency landing
failure_modes.mitigation: Respect altitude-derated payload limits; monitor ESC temps; firmware updates

failure_modes.name: RTK base link dropout
failure_modes.mitigation: Relocate base station; use NTRIP network RTK fallback

failure_modes.name: Radar terrain-follow error over dense crops
failure_modes.mitigation: Set conservative follow height; calibrate radar; avoid extreme slope missions

failure_modes.name: Battery swell from fast-charge heat cycling
failure_modes.mitigation: Charge at 15-45°C cell temp, use DJI inverter-generator profiles, retire swollen packs

failure_modes.name: Spreader disc motor jam
failure_modes.symptoms: Uneven granule distribution, spreader current alarms
failure_modes.mitigation: Clean hopper and discs after use; keep granules dry
